original: The Jungfrau-Aletsch Region was chosen as the first Alpine UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site in [dated source]. At its heart lies the mighty rock massif of the Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau and the glacial landscape around the Great Aletsch Glacier.
